attribute.name.ftb.lh_blood_needles.desc: When you strike an enemy, your Vaettir companion has a 25% chance to fire Blood Needles at the target. Rank scales the spell level.
attribute.name.ftb.lh_death_defiance.des: On lethal damage, your Vaettir cancels your death and detonates a knockback ring around you. 60-second cooldown.
attribute.name.ftb.lh_eclipse_strike.des: When you strike an enemy, your Vaettir has a 20% chance to cast Echoing Strikes on you for extra hits. Rank scales the spell level.
attribute.name.ftb.lh_fire_ward.desc: When you take fire damage, your Vaettir grants Fire Resistance. Rank scales the buff duration.
attribute.name.ftb.lh_frost_aura.desc: When hostile mobs come within 8 blocks, your Vaettir has a 25% chance to cast Frostwave around you. Rank scales the spell level.
attribute.name.ftb.lh_frost_hex.desc: When you take damage, your Vaettir has a 30% chance to apply a random debuff to nearby foes. Rank scales debuff duration.
attribute.name.ftb.lh_heat_surge.desc: When your health drops below 12 HP, your Vaettir has a 50% chance to cast Heat Surge. Rank scales the spell level.
attribute.name.ftb.lh_inferno_armor.desc: When you take damage, your Vaettir has a 30% chance to grant Fortify and Fire Resistance. Rank scales the duration.
attribute.name.ftb.lh_serpents_gift.desc: When you take damage, your Vaettir has a 25% chance to grant a random positive buff. Rank scales the buff duration.
attribute.name.ftb.lh_shadow_step.desc: When you take damage, your Vaettir has a 25% chance to cast Blood Step, repositioning you out of harm. Rank scales the spell level.
attribute.name.ftb.lh_shockwave.desc: When you take damage with mobs in melee range, your Vaettir casts Gust to push them back. Rank scales the spell level.
attribute.name.ftb.lh_soul_devour.desc: When you kill an enemy, your Vaettir casts Blessing of Life on you. Rank scales the blessing level.
attribute.name.ftb.lh_soul_heal.desc: When your health drops below 15 HP, your Vaettir has an 80% chance to cast Heal on you. Rank scales the heal strength.
attribute.name.ftb.lh_spectral_phase.des: When you take damage, your Vaettir has a 25% chance to wrap you in protective Oakskin. Rank scales the buff strength.
attribute.name.ftb.lh_spirit_attack.desc: When you strike an enemy while holding a Malum Spirit Pouch, your Vaettir has a 25% chance to release stored spirits as an attack. Rank scales the damage.
attribute.name.ftb.lh_spirit_release.des: When you take damage while holding a Malum Spirit Pouch, your Vaettir has a 25% chance to release stored spirits in retaliation. Rank scales the burst strength.
attribute.name.ftb.lh_spirit_shield.desc: When you are struck by an arrow, your Vaettir casts Shield on you. Rank scales the buff duration.
attribute.name.ftb.lh_tidal_pull.desc: When you strike an enemy, your Vaettir has a 20% chance to cast Black Hole, pulling foes toward your target. Rank scales the spell level.
attribute.puffish_attributes.fortune.des: Bonus Fortune levels added to your mining drops. Granted by the Alfheim skill tree.
attribute.puffish_attributes.magic_damag: Bonus magic damage applied to spells and magic trinkets. Granted by Mimir's Well (Magic skill tree).
attribute.puffish_attributes.magic_resis: Multiplier on incoming magic damage taken. Granted by the Muspelheim and Alfheim skill trees.
attribute.puffish_attributes.melee_damag: Multiplier on melee weapon damage. Granted by the Hel and Niflheim skill trees.
attribute.puffish_attributes.melee_resis: Multiplier on incoming melee damage taken. Granted by the Muspelheim and Midgard skill trees.
attribute.puffish_attributes.natural_reg: Multiplier on passive health regeneration. Granted by the Jotunheim, Niflheim, and Muspelheim skill trees. Becomes very strong at higher ranks.
attribute.puffish_attributes.pickaxe_spe: Multiplier on pickaxe mining speed. Granted by the Muspelheim and Midgard skill trees.
attribute.puffish_attributes.ranged_dama: Multiplier on bow and crossbow damage. Granted by the Hel and Jotunheim skill trees.
attribute.puffish_attributes.ranged_resi: Multiplier on incoming ranged damage taken. Granted by the Muspelheim and Alfheim skill trees.
Generic damage reduction multiplier applied after type-specific resistances. Granted by the Muspelheim skill tree.
attribute.puffish_attributes.stamina.des: Sprint and jump endurance pool. Granted by every realm's skill tree.

ftb.little_helper.ambient.asgard_gold: There are still bits of gold in the stonework. Someone thought 'this arch needs to cost a fortune' and they spent hours on it and it's still here. Hi little gold bits.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.asgard_islands: What do you think is holding up these floating islands. Did nobody tell them gravity was a thing? Who decided that was okay? I have so many questions and I feel like none of the answers will make sense.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.asgard_ruins: Every time I look at these ruins, I see something that was beautiful once. A carving. A window frame. Someone made all of this with love. We should put it back the way it was. Better, even.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.asgard_sky: The sky above Asgard is still beautiful. Whatever happened down here, whatever fell and burned and broke... the sky watched it all happen. It's still the same sky it always was. I find that either very comforting or very sad, I can't decide which.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.asgard_valkyri: I keep expecting to see those Valkyries flying around here. Do you think they still come here? Maybe they just... don't go into the parts that are ruined? I hope they don't come back. I hope they live somewhere else.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.bifrost_elevat: Hey I think I hear people below us, we should use this elevator and go down and see who's there!
ftb.little_helper.ambient.building_1: I like it when you build things. Fighting is scary, but building... building means we're making something instead of breaking something. That's nice.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.building_2: Oh, that's clever! I wouldn't have put it THERE, but I also have no idea how to build anything, so... very clever. Yes. Great choice.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.building_3: Sometimes I have this thought that whatever you're making will still be here many years from now. I wonder what those people will think you were trying to do.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.day_1: Oh, it's morning! The sun is actually coming up! I feel much better with the sun in the sky. Not that I was worried before. Just... the sun is very reassuring. Good morning, sun.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.day_2: Everything looks different in the daylight. Friendlier. Less like it's about to eat us. That's the best kind of different.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.day_3: Right! New day! We can do anything! We have a WHOLE day ahead of us and none of the night monsters will come out! This is peak us. What are we doing first?
ftb.little_helper.ambient.food_1: Are you going to eat? Can I have some? I don't actually need to eat, I think. But I like pretending.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.food_2: What IS that? It smells sooo nice! I've never tasted anything. I keep meaning to try to but I don't ... actually, how do you eat? And where does it even go?
ftb.little_helper.ambient.food_3: You should eat a wider variety of foods. I feel like you just eat the same thing... Aren't you bored of that? Then again I don't eat so maybe I don't get it.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.hel_bones: There are a LOT of bones here. Who even has so many bones? Actually, don't tell me. I don't want to know whose bones these are.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.hel_cold: There's no wind here but I keep feeling like something just passed through me. I definitely don't enjoy that.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.hel_quiet: Even your footsteps sound wrong here. Too quiet. Like the ground is absorbing them. Like it doesn't want to draw attention to us. Smart ground.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.hel_shadows: I keep seeing shadowy things move in the corner of my eyes. I sure hope they are just shadows.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.hel_spirits: Do you think the spirits here know they're dead? Or do they just wander around wondering why nobody talks to them?
ftb.little_helper.ambient.idle_1: Hey. HEY. Are you still there? You're just there... still. Please don't do that. It reminds me of when you were lying on the ground in Helheim and I didn't know if you were ever going to wake up.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.idle_2: What are you thinking about right now? You tend to just stop sometimes and I can't tell if you're still there or not... I'd ask but I don't want to interrupt. ...I'm asking anyway. What are you thinking about?
ftb.little_helper.ambient.idle_3: I'm fine just floating here. I don't need to be doing anything. This is nice. Just existing. Quietly. Together. ...Okay I lied, I'm a little bored. Can we do something?
ftb.little_helper.ambient.jotunheim_cold: M-my blood is f-freezing. Do I even have blood? Whatever I have instead of blood, it's f-freezing.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.jotunheim_gian: I wonder if the Frost Giants look at us the way we look at bugs? I don't want to be a bug. I feel like I understand how they feel now.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.jotunheim_mist: There's mist rolling in from the valleys. Low and slow. In any other realm I'd say that's just bad weather. In this Realm... I'm less confident about that.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.jotunheim_size: Everything here is just... the wrong size. Not scary-wrong, just wrong-wrong. Like someone made a world and then forgot to check the scale.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.jotunheim_soun: What was that sound? That really low rumbling sound? ...Oh. Oh it's just the wind passing through the mountains. Just the wind. We're fine.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.look: You've got that look again. The 'Thinking very hard about something' look. I know all of your looks and this one's my favourite... It means we'll be doing something fun soon.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.midgard_animal: Look at that little creature over there! Just... living and enjoying its life. Not trying to kill us. Not cursed. Not on fire. Just existing. Being a little creature. I could watch it all day. Can we watch it all day?
ftb.little_helper.ambient.midgard_birds: There's a bird singing! Not because it's warning other birds about us, not because it's cursed... just because it's happy to sing! Because it wants to! Oh, I love this place. I love it SO much.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.midgard_flower: FLOWERS! Real actual flowers! Can I... can we stop for just one second? I've never seen flowers before! Well, I've seen dead flowers. These are so much better than dead flowers!
ftb.little_helper.ambient.midgard_green: Everything is so... green. I didn't know how much I missed green. I don't think I've ever had green before, but I missed it anyway. Does that make sense? Can you miss something you've never had?
ftb.little_helper.ambient.midgard_wind: Do you feel this breeze? Real wind... passing around us, instead of through us. It doesn't carry ash, or freeze you solid, or smell like something died. It's just... wind. Soft wind that smells of grass.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.mining_1: You really like digging holes, don't you? That's not a criticism! Holes are great. Some of the best things are in holes. Ores. Caves. More holes.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.mining_2: You never know, the next swing might be diamonds! Or a cave! Or a horrible monster den! The horrible monster den is less exciting but the diamonds make up for it.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.mining_3: The sound that tools makes is actually kind of satisfying. Tink. Tink tink. Tink. It's rhythmic. Relaxing, even... Not the time to snooze!
ftb.little_helper.ambient.muspelheim_ash: There's ash falling. Gently. Like snow. But... ash. I keep almost saying 'oh how pretty' and then it gets in my mouth and I regret ever thinking that.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.muspelheim_cre: The things that live here CHOSE this. They look at all the fire and the heat and the molten everything and they go 'this is home'. That's very weird, right? Or maybe I'm weird...
ftb.little_helper.ambient.muspelheim_hea: I can feel my wings getting singed. Just a little. At the very tips. I'm not mentioning it because I want to complain, I'm mentioning it because I feel you should have this information.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.muspelheim_lav: That lava looks... really pretty, actually. From a distance. A VERY safe distance. The prettiest things in these Realms are always the things that kill you.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.muspelheim_sky: The sky is the wrong color. It's been the wrong color since we got here. Red isn't a sky color! Well, okay, sometimes at sunset. But this isn't a sunset.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.niflheim_dark: I do wish that we could see anything. LITERALLY anything at all. Maybe if we both look in the same direction we can see a little bit more? ...No? Okay. Just checking.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.niflheim_lost: If we get separated in this darkness, how will you find me? How will I find you? ...Actually no. I don't want to make loud sounds here. Just... stay close. Very close.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.niflheim_quiet: Is it just me, or is it way too quiet here? I'd rather hear something scary than hear nothing at all. At least then I'd know where it is.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.niflheim_shape: I keep thinking I see shapes in the mist. Like outlines of things. Big things. I'm going to stop looking at the mist. I'm just going to look at you.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.niflheim_smell: This place smells quite... odd. It's not foul, it's just... old. It smells old! Really, really old. Like opening an old sealed loot chest after a thousand years.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.night_1: It's getting dark. I don't love when it gets dark. Not because I'm scared! I'm not scared. I just... prefer when I can see what's trying to kill us. That's practical, not scared.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.night_2: Oh! Stars. There are actual stars up there. I forgot about stars. Do you think the stars can see us? That sounds scary but I mean it in a nice way.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.night_3: Things are starting to move around out there. In the dark. I can hear them. That's fine! We've handled worse. Much worse... I'm just saying it out loud so we both remember.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.noise: Did you hear that? ...No? Maybe it was nothing... It was definitely something...
ftb.little_helper.ambient.shiny: Ooh, what's that shiny thing over there? Can we go look? ...No? Okay. But it was VERY shiny.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.sky: I keep forgetting to look up. When I do, I feel like everything is a lot bigger than I remember. In a good way, mostly.
ftb.little_helper.ambient.sneeze: Did you just... was that a sneeze? Are you getting sick? I could hover closer? I don't actually know if that helps... I just want to help.
ftb.little_helper.player_death.1: No no no no NO! ...Oh. Oh, you're back. You're okay? Don't DO that to me! My little heart can't take it! ...Do I have a heart? The point is DON'T DIE.
ftb.little_helper.player_death.10: I think I aged about fifty years just now. I don't much about the concept of aging, but I feel it. I feel it in my bones... Do I even have bones? Fine! I feel it in my wings.
ftb.little_helper.player_death.2: That looked like it hurt. A lot. Like, a LOT a lot. Maybe we should try a different strategy? I don't have one. But we should try one.
ftb.little_helper.player_death.3: Okay so what we just did? Let's never do that again. Let's do the opposite of that. I don't know what the opposite is, but it involves less dying.
ftb.little_helper.player_death.4: NOPE. Nope nope nope. I refuse to accept that. ...Oh good, you're back. I was about to have a very small crisis. I mean I'm STILL having one, but at least you're here for it.
ftb.little_helper.player_death.5: Okay so I saw that whole thing and I have NOTES. First: ow. Second: really ow. Third: I am so glad you can apparently just... come back from that? Because I cannot do this alone. I am very much a support role.
ftb.little_helper.player_death.6: ...You know what, I'm not going to say anything. I'm just going to stand here and wait for you to come back, and when you do, I'm going to pretend that didn't happen, and we are NEVER going to discuss it.
ftb.little_helper.player_death.7: Aaaand there you go AGAIN! We really should fix that habit of yours. Could we try to die less? As a personal favor to me?
ftb.little_helper.player_death.8: Right. Okay. That was bad. That was really bad. But you always come back. You ALWAYS come back. ...You're coming back, right? RIGHT? Okay. Okay good. Please stop doing that!
ftb.little_helper.player_death.9: I keep thinking I'll get used to this. I won't. I am never going to get used to this. Every single time it's like the first time and every single time I think 'surely this is the worst one' and then somehow the NEXT one is worse!
ftb.little_helper.skill.blood_needles.1: By seidr and spite... seek them out!
ftb.little_helper.skill.blood_needles.2: Venom of Nidhoggr, find your mark!
ftb.little_helper.skill.death_defiance.1: The Valkyries circle... but not yet! Rise!
ftb.little_helper.skill.death_defiance.2: Hel shall not have you while I draw breath!
ftb.little_helper.skill.eclipse_strike.1: Fenrir swallows the sun... strike in the dark!
ftb.little_helper.skill.eclipse_strike.2: Let the shadow of Ragnarok fall upon them!
ftb.little_helper.skill.fire_ward.1: Surtr's flames know their own... they spare you!
ftb.little_helper.skill.fire_ward.2: The fire bows to Muspelheim's pact!
ftb.little_helper.skill.frost_aura.1: Let the frost of Niflheim consume them!
ftb.little_helper.skill.frost_aura.2: The cold embrace of Niflheim binds them!
ftb.little_helper.skill.frost_hex.1: Skadi's curse be upon you, wretch!
ftb.little_helper.skill.frost_hex.2: Ice and ruin... a gift from the north!
ftb.little_helper.skill.heat_surge.1: The fire in your veins... feel it rise!
ftb.little_helper.skill.heat_surge.2: Ember and fury surge through you!
ftb.little_helper.skill.inferno_armor.1: Muspelheim's fire tempers your flesh and steel!
ftb.little_helper.skill.inferno_armor.2: Surtr's flames cloak you... let them try!
ftb.little_helper.skill.oakskin.2: Let oak and ash turn the blade!
ftb.little_helper.skill.serpents_gift.1: The World Serpent stirs... his blessing upon you!
ftb.little_helper.skill.serpents_gift.2: Jormungandr's gift, drawn from the deep!
ftb.little_helper.skill.shadow_step.1: Into the dark between the worlds... move!
ftb.little_helper.skill.shadow_step.2: Walk where Hel walks... unseen, swift!
ftb.little_helper.skill.shockwave.2: Back, curs! The thunder drives you hence!
ftb.little_helper.skill.soul_devour.1: Their wyrd becomes ours... consume it!
ftb.little_helper.skill.soul_devour.2: Your soul feeds the saga now!
ftb.little_helper.skill.soul_heal.1: Hold fast! The Norns have not cut your thread yet.
ftb.little_helper.skill.spirit_release.1: Spirits of the fallen, answer your new master!
ftb.little_helper.skill.spirit_release.2: Rise, restless dead, for your fury is ours!
ftb.little_helper.skill.spirit_shield.1: Aegir's shield holds! Their arrows shall not pass!
ftb.little_helper.skill.spirit_shield.2: Arrows returned to sender, by Odin's will!
ftb.little_helper.skill.tidal_pull.1: Ran's net draws all to the deep!
ftb.little_helper.skill.tidal_pull.2: The tide of Aegir obeys... come to us!
ftb.little_helper.skill_catalyst.tooltip: Sneak + Scroll to cycle through skills!
Sneak + Right-click to activate / deactivate the selected skill!
ftb.little_helper.voice_over.lore.first_: Oh! Oh, you're awake! I was starting to worry! You were lying there for SO long and you smelled really bad. I mean, you still smell bad, but at least now your eyes are open! I'm... hmm. I don't actually know what I am. But I know I'm bound to you! So, um, what do we do now?
ftb.little_helper.voice_over.lore.hel_in: Okay, okay, she's REALLY scary but I noticed something... she's only half... alive? Dead? I don't know the word. But you should watch out for the spirits she summons! They leave bad stuff on the ground. Don't stand in the bad stuff. That's my tip. Don't stand in the bad stuff.
ftb.little_helper.voice_over.lore.hel_mi: She's making copies of herself! Which one is real? I... I can't tell either. Try hitting them! The fake ones should go away when you hit them... I think... Don't quote me on that.
ftb.little_helper.voice_over.lore.jormun: A giant serpent. Of COURSE it's a giant serpent. Why is everything in these realms either giant or on fire or both? Watch the ground... when it goes under, those ripple things show where it's coming back up. Don't be standing there when it does!
It went under! Keep an eye on the frost trails... that's where it's going to come back! Get away from them! Far away! VERY far away!
ftb.little_helper.voice_over.lore.nidhog: That lava stream thing just took away your fire protection! You've got to move NOW... it's about to breathe fire and you are NOT equipped for that anymore! GO GO GO!

Are we... inside it? We're INSIDE the thing. I'm trying very hard NOT to think about what that means. The acid pools will eat through everything, the lava is... well, it's lava, and these... things... I think they're parts of it? Like... its immune system? We're basically a germ it's trying to get rid of. Lovely.
ftb.little_helper.voice_over.lore.react_: So this is Asgard. It's... I thought it would be shinier. The stories make it sound so bright and golden and... oh. Oh no. It was, wasn't it? It was all of those things, and now it's... this. I'm sorry. I don't know why I'm sorry, but I am. We'll fix it though, right? We can fix it now. We fixed everything else. Mostly by hitting it, but still. I know we'll figure this out.

This place is... really dark. And it smells like... hmm, I don't have a word for it. Is 'dead' a smell? I think 'dead' is a smell. Stay close to me! Or, um, I'll stay close to you. That's probably better.

WHOA. Look at those mountains! They go up FOREVER! And the trees... the TREES! I could fit inside one of those leaves! ...Can I PLEASE try to fit inside one of those leaves. Wait - is it supposed to be this cold? Why is everything so BIG? I don't like being small in a big place. Actually, I don't like being cold either. Can we go somewhere warm after this?

Oh. Oh, this is... this is NICE. Look - grass! Real grass! And there's a real sky that isn't trying to crush us or burn us or freeze us! Is that... is that a BIRD? Just a regular bird? Not a death bird or a fire bird or an ice bird - just a bird! Oh... I could cry. I think I'm going to cry. This is the most beautiful place I've ever seen. I mean, it IS only the fifth place I've ever seen, but still!

OKAY so I asked for somewhere warm and THIS IS TOO WARM. Everything is on fire! The ground is on fire! The AIR is on fire! How is air on fire?! I take it back, I want the cold place again. ...No I don't. I don't want any of these places. I want a meadow. With flowers. Do any of these places have flowers?

I can't see anything... Not a single thing! This mist is... it's like being inside a cloud, but the cloud doesn't like you. Do you hear that? It sounds like... whispering? No. No, I don't want to hear whispering. I'm going to think about nice things. Like sunshine. And warm rocks. And places where things don't whisper at you from the fog.
ftb.little_helper.voice_over.lore.surtur: He just got glowy! That means his armor is doing the thing... you can't hurt him much right now and he'll burn you if you get close. Back off and wait it out! Patience! I know patience isn't our strong suit but TRY!

Everything about him is on fire. His sword is on fire. His ARMOR is on fire. I think his FIRE is on fire. When he does that ground slam thing, the lava pools stick around, so don't get trapped! Keep moving!
ftb.little_helper.voice_over.lore.wolves: There's TWO of them?! That's not fair! That's the opposite of fair! Okay... they're going to try to split up for a flank attack. Don't let one sneak up behind you while you're fighting the other. They're wolves! This is how they hunt... they WANT you to tunnel vision!

Watch out! If you ignore one for too long it'll pounce on you and pin you down! Keep switching between them! I know it's hard but you've fought GODS. You can handle two puppies. Big, scary, celestial puppies. With teeth. Waiting to rip you apart
ftb.little_helper.voice_over.lore.ymir_i: He's... he's SO big. How do you fight something that big? His feet are bigger than us! Okay, okay, think... ICE. He's made of ice. What beats ice? FIRE. Hit him with fire! Do you have fire? Please tell me you have fire.
ftb.little_helper.voice_over.lore.ymir_s: MOVE MOVE MOVE! When he lifts his foot like that, he's going to STOMP and the ground goes all spiky! Don't be where the spikes are! I know that's obvious but I'm PANICKING!
ftb.maze.anxiety_sand.start: Eek! Doesn't sand like this fall if you update it?
ftb.maze.arrow_trap.start: Watch out for the string! Maybe you can sneak around it...
ftb.maze.boss_defeated: Yay! We did it! That one won't be bothering us again!
ftb.maze.boss_encounter: Eep! A big baddie! Ready yourself!
ftb.maze.bullshit_walkway.start: I don't trust this room one bit!
ftb.maze.burnout_puzzle.start: Teehee! I see flicky levers, I love them <3
ftb.maze.completed_chat: You've completed the maze! You should now be able to return home by walking into the End Gateway.
ftb.maze.completed_chat_repeat: You have already completed the maze! Return home by walking into the End Gateway.
ftb.maze.dash.start: These runes fly you forward! It may be tricky to go straight across in one leap though...
ftb.maze.debuff.warning.0: §5[Hel]§f I see you. Leave... before what follows becomes harder to bear.
ftb.maze.debuff.warning.1:
§5[Hel]§f My caution went unheeded. Hunger gnaws at you and weakness shall follow in its wake.
 Do not linger.
When your heart drums ten more times, the burden will deepen.
ftb.maze.debuff.warning.2:
§5[Hel]§f Your strength begins to fail.
Pain will follow with every breath. Leave now, or the next ten breaths will break you further.
ftb.maze.debuff.warning.3:
§5[Hel]§f Still you remain... Stubborn as ever.
I will sharpen the pain.
Your next punishment awaits only a couple more breaths away.
ftb.maze.debuff.warning.4:
§5[Hel]§f You tread beyond all bounds.
Remain, and you shall join the inhabitants of this Realm within moments.
Should you flee, even then this curse shall cling to you.
This is my final warning. Ignore it and you will endure the full strength of my wrath.
ftb.maze.debuff.warning.5:
§5[Hel]§f Very impressive! You are among the first to endure my power.
I will leave you be in your futile attempt to conquer the knowledge within this vault.
The burden remains, however. Though it will grow no further.
ftb.maze.elemental_runes.start: These are elemental runes! They are usually all harmful, but your powers will protect you from falls...
ftb.maze.empty_hand_required: You must use an empty hand to complete the maze.
ftb.maze.entrance.start: Woah, where are the doorways? And why is light coming from the middle of these walls...
ftb.maze.fake_floor.start: Watch out! The pattern on this floor means danger! The obvious way is not the right one...
ftb.maze.fan_pull_pakour.start: This looks tricky... make sure you swing back and build up some speed first.
ftb.maze.final_room.start: Wow, you made it! Those are the spellbooks!
ftb.maze.first_vault.start: Looks like we need a key... hmm, this looks like the spawners from earlier!

ftb.maze.hint.at_end: We made it to the heart of the maze! The altar should be right here. Awaken it!
ftb.maze.hint.east: This way, this way! The path winds off to the §feast§r. Come on!
ftb.maze.hint.no_path: Hmm... the walls are all jumbled and I can't find the way from here. Take a few steps and ask me again!
ftb.maze.hint.north: Ooh, I can feel the way! We should head §fnorth§r from here. Follow me!
ftb.maze.hint.not_in_maze: Silly! I can only sniff out the path while we're inside the maze.
ftb.maze.hint.south: I think... yes! We need to go §fsouth§r next. Stick close!
ftb.maze.hint.west: My whiskers are tingling, the way out is to the §fwest§r! Let's go!
ftb.maze.jump_lava.start: These runes are the kind to send up into the air! This will be fun ^_^
ftb.maze.kinetic_rune_tutorial.start: These are magic runes! These ones are safe, feel free to try them.
ftb.maze.magic_selection.start: Oh! That sign says to walk the path of magic! What are those levers for...
ftb.maze.not_in_maze: You must be inside the maze to interact with this.
ftb.maze.nozzle_shitshow.start: Ahhh! This fan sucks! We need to sneak out of it when it's safe to do so.
ftb.maze.piston_pit.start: watch out! It's safest to go right after the piston in front of you retracts.
ftb.maze.shulkers.start: What are those on the ceiling? Can they help us if we get stuck there?
ftb.maze.sky_walkway.start: Be careful! The floor here is odd for you to see, look for clues to help.
ftb.maze.spell_walkway.start: What's that on the ceiling? It feels like something will happen if I look right at it.
ftb.maze.spot_the_difference.start: Hm, this pattern is intracate, but the signs claim a corner is different...
ftb.maze.trapped_chest.start: There's something... off about this room. Be careful...
ftb.maze.trapped_floor.start: Hm, usually chests are in the middle of a room, not along a wall...
ftb.maze.turret_decoy.start: I don't get it... those pressure plates can't power the turrets... am I missing something?
ftb.maze.turret_dodge.start: Careful! These projectiles home to you, better be quick!
ftb.maze.turret_tangle.start: Hm, how would we get out? Those turrets can clear a path, but they are blocked by pillars.

ftb.scroll.allfather.title: The Allfather Speaks
ftb.scroll.allfather_intro.text:
Hear me, wanderer,
for I shall speak and the worlds shall listen.

I have hung upon the wind-swept trees,
I have drunk deep from the well of knowing,
and I have watched the threads of fate twist
and fray across the ages.

The saga I tell now is not one of glory;
 at least, not yet.

It is the tale of a soul cast down,
stripped of name and memory,
condemned to rot among the dishonored dead.

But the Norns weave strange patterns,
and even the fallen may yet rise
to grasp the threads of a different fate.

You stand at the threshold of the nine realms.
Before you walk them...
you must remember what you are.

Or rather... what you were.
ftb.scroll.asgard_arrival.text:
It is finished.
The corpse-gnawer's coils loosen,
and for the first time in an age,
the roots of the World Tree draw breath
without teeth at their throat.

You have done what Gods and heroes could not.
What the Allfather... could not.

As Nidhoggr dies,
his venom-tongue spits one last truth:
that you were his instrument.
That the ruin of Asgard
was wrought by your hands.
And the serpent does not lie.

Before the grave. Before the forgetting.
You were something else.
The child of Hel and a mortal man,
born between death and life,
carrying the blood of Gods
in a body the Gods never claimed.

You were powerful.
And Nidhoggr found you.
Whispered to you.
Turned your strength into a
weapon aimed at the golden halls.

Fenrir's chains; you broke them.
The Bifrost; you shattered it.
The halls of the Aesir; you burned them,
and did not even know whose hand held the torch.
These were your sins.
Unremembered, but yours.

Yet hear me now, half-blood,
and hear me as the voice of one
who has traded an eye for wisdom
and hung nine nights for the knowing of truth:
what was broken by deceit can be reforged by will.

This is what remains of Asgard.
Shattered spires grasping at
a sky that has forgotten gold.
The Bifrost in splinters.

The mead halls silent as barrows.
You tore this apart. Now build it back.
Stone by stone, rune by rune,
until the nine realms look upon these halls
and remember what they were.

This is not punishment. This is purpose.

The Norns have woven you a thread no seer predicted;
 not redemption given, but redemption forged,
in fire and frost and the blood of monsters.

Take it. Build.

And prove that the hand which broke Asgard
is the same hand that can make it whole.
ftb.scroll.asgard_restored.text:
Look upon what you have wrought,
child of Hel, blood of the divine,
born between death and the living world.

Where there was ruin,
halls rise golden against the sky.
Where there was silence,
the songs of the Aesir
echo again through timber and stone.

The Bifrost blazes from horizon to horizon,
its light reaching across all nine realms
like outstretched arms welcoming the lost home.

You crawled from a nameless grave in Helheim,
broken, reeking of death,
stripped of every memory
and every scrap of the power
that once made realms tremble at your name.

And now you stand in Asgard,
surrounded by the proof of
what a condemned soul can become
when it chooses to build rather than destroy.

I watched you face the frost of Jotunheim
and the silence of Niflheim.
I watched you walk through Surtr's fire
and stand against the wolves of Midgard.
I watched you tear yourself free
from the belly of the World Serpent
with nothing but fury and the stolen strength of spirits.

And I tell you now,
with the voice of one who has seen the birth of worlds
and the death of Gods:
the Allfather himself could not have done better.

The saga of your exile is ended.
The saga of the Architect begins.

Go well, half-blood.
The nine realms are watching,
and for the first time in a long age...
they are not afraid of what they see.

And should the darkness coil again
at the roots of the World Tree...
I trust you will know what to do.
You always did.

You always did have your mother's stubbornness.
And your father's heart.
ftb.scroll.helheim_arrival.text:
Your eyes open to the reek of ash and rot,
and the black breath of Helheim
fills your lungs like a curse.
Cold stone beneath you,
slick with the filth of the grave.

Your hands; scarred, broken, reeking of death;
 press against the dark and push.
You rise, though everything in this forsaken place
whispers that you should not.

This is Helheim.
The shore of the dishonored dead,
where those judged unworthy
are cast to wander for eternity.

You remember nothing.
No name. No deeds. No sin.
Only the ache of a body that has been
broken and remade by something terrible,
and a fire in the blood that will not die;
 divine fire, though you do not yet know it.

You are more than mortal, child.
The blood of Gods runs in your veins,
thin and tainted though it may be.
But blood alone will not free you.

The spirits of the dead
cling to your power even in death;
 tear it from them.
Drink deep of their strength,
for it was once yours to command.

Hel herself bars the only gate from this place.
Your mother, though she will not call you so.
Face her.
Prove that even the condemned
can still bare their teeth.
ftb.scroll.helheim_departure.text:
The Goddess of the dead yields her gate,
and the dishonored dead watch in silence
as one of their own walks free.
You struck at divinity and did not falter.
Good.

That fire in your blood; you felt it, did you not?
When her spells broke against you,
when her spirits could not hold you.

That was no mortal strength.
Remember that feeling.
You will need it.

But hear me well:
Hel tested your will.
What waits beyond will test your flesh, your mind,
and every scrap of stolen power you carry.

And there is something else.
A shadow that moves between the realms,
old as the roots of Yggdrasil,
with scales like night and hunger without end.
It has noticed you.

Keep your blade sharp and your wits sharper.
ftb.scroll.jotunheim_arrival.text:
The wind-bite of Jotunheim strikes
before your eyes find the horizon.
A cold that cares nothing for armor or will;
 it reaches through iron and
bone alike and grips the marrow.

This is the realm of the Jotnar, the frost-giants,
the old enemies of Asgard.

Everything here was wrought for titans.
Mountains that pierce the roof of the sky.
Trees vast enough to shelter
whole clans beneath a single bough.
Rivers of grinding ice that have carved these valleys
since before mankind drew its first breath.

You are small here. You are prey.

The spirits of this land are powerful;
 ancient frost-bound things that
hoard their strength jealously.
Take it from them.
Every spirit felled, every fragment of power reclaimed,
brings you closer to what you once were.

But the greatest of all waits at the summit. Ymir.
The first of all giants, father of frost,
whose bones became the mountains
and whose blood became the sea.

He has stood since before Odin hung upon the tree.
He will not kneel to the likes of you.
Make him.
ftb.scroll.jotunheim_departure.text:
The frost-father falls,
and the mountains weep ice from their wounds.

You have ended something older than memory,
older than the Gods themselves.
Ymir's blood made the oceans. His skull became the sky.
And you brought him low.

The power you tore from his dying breath;
 hold it close.
It burns cold, but it is yours by right of conquest,
as the old ways demand.

Ahead lies fire. Surtr's domain cares nothing
for frost-hardened steel or a giant-killer's pride.

In Muspelheim, only the unburnable survive.
ftb.scroll.midgard_arrival.text:
Breathe, child.
Let the fresh air fill your lungs;
 clean air, untainted by grave-rot or brimstone.

Midgard. The middle realm.
The hearth-fire around which
all other worlds are gathered.

Green hills beneath an honest sky,
rivers that run with water and not venom,
trees that stand at a size the mind can hold.

For a wanderer who has
crawled through Helheim's filth,
braved the frost of giants,
choked on the mists of the dead,
and walked through
the flame that ends worlds;
 this is as close to Valhalla
as the living may know.

Rest here. Eat. Mend your armor.
Let the spirits of this gentle land
offer what strength they have;
 it is freely given, not torn away.
Midgard has always been kind
to those who respect it.

But Midgard is also where
the great hunts have always ended.
Skoll and Hati stalk these lands;
 the twin wolves, children of Fenrir,
born to chase the sun and moon
until the end of days.
They are the last gate between you and Asgard,
and they hunt as one.

Enjoy the sunlight while it lasts, half-blood.
Those two have been trying to swallow it
since the dawn of time.
ftb.scroll.midgard_nidhoggr.text:
The sun-chaser and the moon-hound fall silent at last.
The key to Asgard gleams in your hand,
heavy with the weight of every realm you have conquered,
every spirit you have claimed.

You are more now than you were
when you crawled from the grave in Helheim.
The stolen strength of Gods and monsters
runs through you like molten rune-metal.
You are nearly what you once were.
Nearly.

But the serpent does not wait for 'nearly.'

The earth splits. The sky blackens.

Nidhoggr rises;
 not as a shadow, not as a whisper,
but as the full and terrible truth of what has been
stalking you since the beginning.

His jaws close around you before
the scream leaves your throat.

Darkness.

The stench of acid and ancient death.
The churning belly of something
that has devoured Gods.

You have been here before.
This is where it began.
Inside the corpse-gnawer,
swallowed and broken and spat into Helheim like offal.

Your memories stir; not yet whole, but enough.
Enough to know that you and this serpent
have unfinished blood between you.

Fight.
Not with the desperation of the condemned,
but with the fury of one who finally remembers
what was taken from them.

Tear your way free.
ftb.scroll.muspelheim_arrival.text:
One breath of cold air.
Then the next sears the throat
like swallowing molten iron.

Welcome to Muspelheim,
realm of the unending flame,
where the earth bleeds fire
and the sky has never known the color of night.

This is Surtr's domain.
The lord of the fire-giants,
the black-sword bearer,
the world-ender.

When Ragnarok came,
it was Surtr who set the final blaze.
When the Gods fell,
it was his flames that consumed their halls.
He was destined to burn everything;
 and he fulfilled that destiny with joy.

You have conquered frost and serpent,
claimed the spirits of the cold realms
and made their power your own.

But fire respects no lineage, half-blood.
Not mortal. Not divine.
Surtr cares only whether you burn.

Prove to him that you do not.
ftb.scroll.muspelheim_nidhoggr.text:
The world-ender falls,
and for one breath the flames of Muspelheim bow low,
as though mourning their king.

You have felled the fire that was to end all things.

The spirits of this realm are yours now;
 their fury, their heat,
bound to your blood and your will.

But that blood... it has drawn something.
You have felt it before;
 the shadow at the edge of sight,
the weight of ancient eyes
in the dark between realms.

Nidhoggr.
The corpse-gnawer.

The dragon that has chewed at the roots of Yggdrasil
since before the first age of Gods.
He has been feeding on the power you leave in your wake,
growing fat on the death of giants and serpents.

And now he rises.

You cannot fight him. Not here. Not yet.
The power you have gathered is vast,
but Nidhoggr is older than that power itself.

There will be a reckoning; but not today.

Run, half-blood.
RUN.
ftb.scroll.niflheim_arrival.text:
You descend into Niflheim,
and the mist drinks you whole.

This cold is not the honest frost of Jotunheim;
 that cold was a blade. This is a poison.
It seeps through skin and thought alike,
whispering in voices half-remembered,
pulling at the edges of your mind
like draugr fingers through grave-soil.

The mists of Niflheim are the oldest thing
in all the nine realms.
Before fire, before frost-giants,
before the Gods drew breath; there was the mist.

It remembers everything.
And it knows what you are, half-blood.
It can taste the divinity in you, thin as it is,
and it is hungry for it.

Guard your strength.
The spirits here will not fight you openly;
 they will try to bleed you slowly, sap you,
until you wander the fog forever.

And coiled in the deepest dark,
where the roots of Yggdrasil plunge into frozen water,
Jormungandr waits. The World Serpent.
Loki's spawn, vast enough to encircle all of Midgard,
patient as a glacier.
He does not need to hunt.
Everything comes to him eventually.
ftb.scroll.niflheim_departure.text:
The World Serpent uncoils its last,
and the mists of Niflheim
draw back like a wound exhaling.

You have done what the Aesir could not at Ragnarok.
Thor himself fell to Jormungandr's venom;
 walked nine steps and dropped.
Yet you stand.

The power that bleeds
from the serpent's corpse; drink it.
You will need every drop.

I wonder, sometimes,
whether the Norns wove this fate
or whether you are tearing new threads
into the tapestry by force.

Either way...
The fires of Muspelheim
will burn such questions to ash.
ftb.scroll.restore_progress1.text:
The first stones rise from the ruin.
A small thing, perhaps.
But the World Tree itself grew
from a single seed in the void.

Build, half-blood.
The nine realms were made one stone at a time.
ftb.scroll.restore_progress2.text:
I see the shape of halls in what you raise.
You build with a warrior's purpose;
 no wasted stone, no hollow flourish.
The Aesir themselves built with less conviction.

Heh.
Do not tell them I said so.
ftb.scroll.restore_progress3.text:
The Bifrost stirs.

By the roots... do you feel that?
The rainbow bridge remembers its shape,
reaching toward your work
like a hound scenting its master's return.

I had thought it lost beyond mending.
You prove the Allfather wrong.
That takes strength few possess.
ftb.scroll.restore_progress4.text:
Asgard kindles.
Faint as the first star after a long winter's night,
but unmistakable.

The Norns wove no thread for this;
 you have carved it yourself,
against fate, against prophecy,
against the death the Gods accepted.

This... this is why I chose you.
